notes: Incremental stories added for core logic robustness, external API handling, and distance computation.

stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Query Builder and Recruiting Filter Logic
stories.description: Implement query construction logic for ClinicalTrials.gov API including condition keyword normalization and enforcing recruiting status filter to ensure only active trials are returned.

stories.title: Trial Location Extraction and Normalization
stories.description: Extract trial site locations from API response and normalize into structured address components (city, state, lat/long if available) for downstream distance computation.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Duration Computation via Google Routes
stories.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each trial site, including fallback handling when routes are unavailable.

stories.title: External API Error Handling and Fallback Strategy
stories.description: Implement robust error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes APIs כולל timeouts, partial failures, and graceful degradation (return trials without distance when needed).
